name: Brush Annotation
description: Hand-brushed ink marks over inline text: underline, double underline, circle, strike, bracket and highlight.

props.name: kind
props.description: The mark. Each is a filled brush stroke that presses in, swells and trails off dry, drawn in the order a hand would. Underline, double, strike and highlight follow every line the text wraps onto; circle rings each line; bracket opens before the first word and closes after the last. Highlight is a wide pale wash behind the text.

props.name: color
props.description: Ink colour. Any CSS colour or variable; use var(--destructive) for corrections. Highlight washes it out to a quarter strength.

props.name: show
props.description: Draws the mark when it turns true and lifts it away when it turns false. Leave it unset to draw the mark once, when the text scrolls into view.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait before the brush starts, for marking several passages in reading order.

props.name: children
props.description: The inline content to mark. It is wrapped in mark for a highlight, s for a strike and span otherwise.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span. Other span props are passed through.
